full_judgment: 6. It appears that the decree-holder bank instituted Mortgage Suit No.9 of 2002 for realization of defaulted loan with interest to the tune of Tk. 10.53.701/- the said suit was decreed on contest on 17.4.2003. The said decree was intimately made final on 10.8.2003. Subsequently the said suit was transferred in the Court of the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Tangail. In that Court the decree-holder bank filed an application for getting certificate of right to transfer the mortgage property in order to realize the decretal dues the Court by the impugned Order No. 118 deated 26.2.2008 allowed the said application. Mr. Mehedi submits that without filing the execution case the application of the decree-holder bank to get possession and certificate to transfer the mortgaged property is unlawful. It appears from the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 that for execution of a decree of Artha Rin Adalat the Ain provided the Provisions of execution in Chapter-VI of the AM, 2003. Section 28 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 provided the provision of Limitation for filing the execution case.
